customer_name.description: Full name of the person who wrote the email

order_id.description: Order number like ORD-12345, or null when the email has none

category.description: billing: charges, payments, invoices, refunds of a charge. shipping: delivery, tracking, address, missing or damaged parcels. technical: a product or app that does not work. account: login, password, profile, personal data. other: anything else.

items.description: Products from the order that the email mentions, with how many were ordered. Empty when there are none.

refund_requested.description: true only if the customer asks for money back
